data.title: FBI nabs US tech exec accused of smuggling $300M in AI chips to China | Fox News Video
data.description: A California tech executive is in federal custody, accused of smuggling over $300 million worth of sensitive AI processors to China. Cameras were rolling as federal surrounded 38-year-old Greg Lui as he arrived at Earthmade Computers in San Gabriel.
